title: A fixed line total part's details give the total and its parts amount
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a line set to a fixed total of $450.00 whose parts come to $210.00, part A among them.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at part A's sell price on the fixed-total line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens with the fixed-total line.

Step 2:

  • The details read "Part of a fixed line total of $450.00 (parts $210.00)".
  • Part A's price shows no Manual icon.
  • The details name Fixed line total as the source.
